info.title: SDDFreak Requirements API
info.description: Internal API for SPEC-001 (Requirements Management System: Core). Internal per §2.1: documented and stable enough for the UI, with no third-party compatibility guarantee.

post.summary: Reset a password with a token (FR-ACC-007)

patch.summary: Rename a project (FR-AUTHZ-005); the key is immutable (FR-PRJ-004)

post.summary: Restore a deleted project within 30 days (FR-PRJ-008)

put.summary: Add a member or change their role (FR-PRJ-006)

patch.summary: Rename or move a category (FR-ORG-001, FR-ORG-003)

delete.summary: Delete a category, reassigning its contents upward (FR-ORG-005)

get.summary: List tags, which also feeds suggestions (FR-ORG-010)

patch.summary: Rename a tag across the project (FR-ORG-011)

delete.summary: Delete a tag, detaching it everywhere (FR-ORG-011)

get.summary: List, filter, sort, and search requirements (FR-SRCH-001…006)
Export the filtered result set as CSV or JSON (FR-SRCH-009)

post.summary: Apply one change to many requirements, all or none (FR-ORG-015)

patch.summary: Update a requirement with optimistic concurrency (FR-REQ-006…010)

post.summary: Duplicate a requirement into a new draft (FR-REQ-015)
Revert content to an earlier revision, as a new revision (FR-AUD-004)
Grant yourself access to a project; always audited (FR-AUTHZ-008)

get.summary: Read and filter the audit log (FR-AUD-007)
